cards.card_text: True or false: In that same seventh year, they'll let the fields lie fallow.
cards.verse_text: Every seventh year we will let the fields lie fallow and will cancel every debt.
cards.snippet: Every seventh year we will let the fields lie fallow and will cancel every debt.

cards.card_text: Solomon says there is abundant food in the fallow ground of the poor.
cards.verse_text: Abundant food is in the fallow ground of the poor, but without justice it is swept away.
cards.snippet: Abundant food is in the fallow ground of the poor, but without justice it is swept away.
